title: CHIC
description: CHIC is an upgradable Minecraft mod featuring a Super Chicken entity that dynamically camouflages its color to match the block it stands on and lays that same block as an egg.
body:
**CHIC** adds a utility mob to the game: the Super Chicken. It is a lag-friendly, highly configurable resource generator designed to duplicate blocks and items without complex machinery.

![Overal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/6eedaaa59cdeeb2a3089dc4182011b464dcf5db5.png)

***

## Getting Started

To get started, simply right-click a vanilla Chicken with a Golden Apple. The chicken will transform into a Super Chicken. By default, it will drop an item corresponding to the block it is standing on.

*   Stand on Log ->  Drops Log
*   Stand on Diamond Ore -> Drops Diamond

## Upgrades & Mechanics

The chicken is fully upgradable. Right-click the entity with the following items to improve its stats.


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Jei](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/21d44be93932b7c13b8d2567def85309ac64d690.png)

## **Core Stats**

*   **Redstone (Speed):** Reduces the time between drops. Can be stacked to make drops nearly instant.
*   **Lapis Lazuli (Yield):** Increases the number of items dropped per cycle.
*   **Diamond (Memory Lock):** Locks the chicken to the current block it is standing on. Once locked, you can move the chicken anywhere, and it will keep producing the original block.

## **Automation & Utility**

*   **Hopper (Auto Export):** Requires Memory Lock. The chicken will automatically push items into adjacent inventories (Chests, Barrels, etc.) instead of dropping them on the ground.

![Hopper (Auto Export)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/1fa9b607a40af3359392605af23720fdb5820a56.png) 

*   **Anvil (No AI):** Weighs the chicken down. It stops moving, cannot be pushed, and uses significantly less server processing power.
*   **Wool (Mute):** Silences the sound effects.

## **Advanced Features**

*   **Slime Ball (Silk Touch):** Forces the chicken to drop the block itself.

![Silk Touch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/262b2b97c4b88546b055b3ccfbabc034b1f422cf.png)

*   **Nether Star (Data Capture):** Allows the chicken to copy TileEntity data. Useful for duplicating Shulker Boxes while keeping their contents.

 ![Data Capture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/28f658d38b06d8a282f767b98cc310c4a2b2f634.png)

## **Mod Support**

*   **Jade / Waila:** Looking at a chicken shows exactly what it is mining, its tier, speed, and lock status. 

 ![Jade Support](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/89c9aa0d924dfbec3e6315bf8437790c0cf02d6e.png)

*   **JEI:** Full support for viewing upgrade recipes and mechanics.

![You can view all available upgrades in-game using JEI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KCdYSiKP/images/0c555a7853e38584306271d2ff951720c114ec0f.png)

*   **Tags:** All upgrade items use Item Tags, meaning modpack developers can easily change "Redstone" to any other item via Data Packs.

</details>



## **Configuration**

Everything is configurable. You can adjust the max speed, drop caps, and global tick rates in the chic-common.toml config file to balance the mod for your specific modpack.

 

### **This is Beta 0.1. We are actively asking for feedback!**
